item.title: Ask HN: Responsible/trustable background check companies?
item.summary: Hi, I am on the board of a community organization that works with kids, and is required by insurance to have key volunteers go though a basic criminal background check. I have a good relationship with these folks and they are well-meaning, but not attuned to tech and privacy the way we are here on HN. Are there a couple of reputable background check companies that do their job, without feeding into the personal data sales/credit/advertising industries? Is there some way to validate their ToS and not agree to broad terms that allow them to do what they want with what they access? PS - Personal or detailed experiences welcome, and obviously please don't post AI-influenced content. I can use a text input box as well as you can. PPS - FWIW I have had a military background check, SF86 and all, and am generally okay with these things existing, but not okay with their ToS allowing or feeding into the surveillance advertising world. Thanks! Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49275020 Points: 4 # Comments: 0
